node.statement: The producer hypotheses for the Stage-3 clause of lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger are now satisfied by nodes 1.1.2 and 1.1.3; equivalently lem-maincb-stage3-raw-merge applies to their explicit bijective four-corner datum with the fixed witnesses. Thus its literal map u_3:B_U oplus B_V->A_R is an extended D_*t_3-isomorphism and ||u_3(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=D_*t_3. Together with node 1.1.1 and epsilon_R<=t_3 from node 1.1.2, this is the explicit eligible raw call asserted in node 1.1.
